rawContent: Since #SBC19 is apparently focusing so much on sexual abuse and the #churchtoo crisis in its midst, here’s a little thread on the origins of the tag and what you need to consider if you wanna do ANYTHING to fix this problem. #sbc #sbc2019 #forsuchatimeasthis #metoo

@iammickyjones @emmykegler My gut says people got overly optimistic because of her engagement with #metoo / #ChurchToo conversations and forgot that not everyone who says they care is actually about true sexual liberation for all

Hi, this is a prime example of how not everyone who says #metoo & #ChurchToo is really invested in healing and justice for everyone. Sometimes those are just buzzwords on the lips of those who are still committed to a theology of sexuality that causes suffering, shame and death.
